name: AnimaVN
source:
Magic, dragons, and tyrannical leaders. Which will bring the world to ruin?

Joan, a member of a humble community of farmers, was born with a severe arcana deficiency, being practically dead at birth. If not for the rapidly developing  technology, he would have had no chance at life, but through intensive  and frequent treatments his condition has stabilized. However, the deficient arcana still poses threats and obstacles to his life. And maybe opportunities, both selfless and selfish.

[From [url=https://yesntpan.itch.io/anima]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
魔法、龙和暴虐的领袖。哪个会导致世界毁灭？

琼是一个卑微农民社区的成员，她出生时就患有严重的奥术缺陷，几乎在出生时就已经死亡。如果不是飞速发展的科技，他根本就没有生命的机会，但经过密集频繁的治疗，他的病情已经稳定下来。然而，奥秘的缺失仍然对他的生命构成威胁和障碍。也许还有机会，既无私又自私。

[来自[url=https://yesntpan.itch.io/anima]Itch.io[/url]]
